description: Yahoo Finance public chart endpoint: daily bars for ^GSPC (S&P 500) as the equity factor. No API key.
permission_basis: Public market data served without authentication by Yahoo's chart endpoint, used for research only; raw payloads are not redistributed. Yahoo Terms of Service reviewed 2026-11-18. This registry entry is an explicit research-use assertion, not a legal determination.
timestamp_basis: Daily bars timestamped at the market open (09:30 ET); the trading date is derived in America/New_York and the close is recorded at 21:00 UTC, matching the FRED convention.
